resources.name: Plane-wave DFT code with PW91 functional and norm-conserving pseudopotentials (CPMD or equivalent such as Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT)

access.notes: Paper used CPMD v3.3; any open-source DFT code supporting PW91, plane-wave basis, and Troullier–Martins pseudopotentials is acceptable.

resources.name: Troullier–Martins norm-conserving pseudopotentials for Si, Al, O, H

access.notes: Available from CPMD distribution or pseudopotential repositories (e.g., pseudo-dojo). Obtain or generate as needed.

resources.name: Crystallographic coordinates of chabazite (SSZ-13) from neutron diffraction by Smith et al. (1997)

access.notes: Trigonal unit cell: a=b=c=9.281 Å, α=β=γ=94.275°. The agent constructs the initial cell from these published coordinates, substituting one Al for Si and placing the proton on O3.
